name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Nash's grade is at least 10% more than the Biology class.
Biology, Workshop, and 91% belong to different classes.
Ellis' grade is at least 10% more than the member of the Drama club.
The class in the Studio's grade is higher than both the Biology class and the member of the Drama club.
The History class' grade is between the member of the Yearbook club and Ellis.
The member of the Robotics club's grade is exactly 10% more than the French class.
Dunn's grade is between the Biology class and the class in the Library.
Nash goes with at most two of Geography, Studio, Rowing, and 86%.
The member of the Drama club has a higher grade than Frost.
